name: The People's Insurance Company (Group) of China Limited
summary: The People's Insurance Company (Group) of China Limited, founded in 1949 and headquartered in Beijing, is an investment holding company mainly active in insurance within China. Its divisions are non-life, life and health insurance, asset management and other services. Property and casualty products cover motor, commercial property, liability, credit, cargo and agricultural risks, and the company also acts as an insurance agent and reinsurer.
